name: Baka to T*st to Shoukanjuu - Ichi Genme ~Hoken Jitsugi~
original_name: バカとテ○トと召喚獣 一限目～保健実技～
source:
Fumizuki Academy has completely reformed its curriculum.
First thing's first, everyone must study "health skills".
Akihisa is signed up for a course in intercourse... what could it mean?

明久被报上了一门性交实践课……这究竟意味着什么？
